scope: NCollection flat set and flat data map non-consuming legacy cursor protocol
rust_test_command: cargo test -p rustycad-tkernel --test flat_legacy_cursor --test ncollection_flat_map --test ncollection_flat_data_map --test flat_map_supplemental --test flat_data_supplemental --test ncollection_flat_maps_api_behavior
behaviors: Repeated More, Key and Value do not move the cursor.
Advance follows the native slot scan and does not return the prior item.
Exhausted Key/Value errors preserve Standard_OutOfRange and native method-specific messages.
Next after exhaustion remains equal to a default/end cursor.
Rust Iterator::next and the legacy methods use the same cursor position.
remaining_limits: FlatDataItems is immutable; native non-consuming ChangeValue and shared mutable cursor aliases remain missing. The two native data iterator constructor rows and ChangeValue remain partial.
